title: One_convenient_button
description: Adds a button that allows you to rewind the world type selection
body:
Hello, everyone. First of all, I strongly recommend that you download projects through the official curseforge and modrinth launchers—this will increase the reward for the creators. Thank you all very much for your support!!!

[![chat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7ba56bdea313f30d12390daaabdd4d5e3893385.webp)](https://discord.gg/s8vZR4PGr2) 

![sup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/878829ad3a0866649e4eb55061f4b833f26a3060.png)

If you're tired of having to scroll through the world type options again after accidentally skipping the one you want, this mod lets you go back to the previous world type or to the very bottom of the list. If you were at the beginning
